***Simpson Diversity Function***

This function calculates the biodiversity index of a specific area, given the total number of species and the number of individuals in each species. Higher index values are associated with lower diversity.

param (input): n_i is the number of individuals of each species

param (input): N is the total number of species

output/return: diversity value (D)

```{r}
#| label: function
#| echo: true

# making my data
species <- as.factor(c("rabbit", "squirrel", "snake", "gopher", "snail"))
obs <- sample(1:100, 5)

data <- data.frame(species, obs)

simpson.div(n_i=data$obs)

```
